duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا
duas.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh, raditu billahi rabban, wa bi Muhammadin rasulan, wa bil-islami dina

meaning.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger. I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as messenger, and with Islam as my religion.

source.ar: رواه مسلم (٣٨٦) — يقال بعد تشهد المؤذن
source.en: Sahih Muslim 386 — said after the muezzin's testimony

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab'ath-hu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa'adtah

meaning.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad the place of nearness and excellence, and raise him to the praised station You promised him.

source.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 614 — said after the adhan

duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah. Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salam, tabarakta dhal-jalali wal-ikram

meaning.en: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace; blessed are You, Owner of majesty and honour.

source.en: Sahih Muslim 591

duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayt, wa la mu'tiya lima mana't, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd

meaning.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and no one's fortune avails him against You.

source.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 844, Sahih Muslim 593

duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. La ilaha illallah, wa la na'budu illa iyyah, lahun-ni'matu wa lahul-fadlu wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan. La ilaha illallahu mukhlisina lahud-dina walaw karihal-kafirun

meaning.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. There is no power and no strength except with Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him; His is the blessing, His is the bounty, and His is the beautiful praise. There is no god but Allah; we are sincere in our devotion to Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.

source.en: Sahih Muslim 594

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanallah

meaning.en: Glory be to Allah.

source.ar: رواه مسلم (٥٩٧) — ثلاثًا وثلاثين دبر كل صلاة
source.en: Sahih Muslim 597 — 33 times after each prayer

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillah

meaning.en: All praise is for Allah.

source.ar: رواه مسلم (٥٩٧) — ثلاثًا وثلاثين دبر كل صلاة
source.en: Sahih Muslim 597 — 33 times after each prayer

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu akbar

meaning.en: Allah is the Greatest.

source.ar: رواه مسلم (٥٩٧) — ثلاثًا وثلاثين دبر كل صلاة
source.en: Sahih Muslim 597 — 33 times after each prayer

duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir

meaning.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

source.en: Sahih Muslim 597 — completing the hundred

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u indahu illa bi'idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-Aliyyul-Azim

meaning.en: Allah — there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Who could intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Most Great.

source.ar: سورة البقرة: ٢٥٥ — بعد كل صلاة (النسائي في الكبرى) وفي الصباح والمساء (الحاكم)، صححهما الألباني — حصن المسلم ٧١ و٧٥
source.en: Quran 2:255 — after each prayer (an-Nasa'i, al-Kubra) and morning and evening (al-Hakim), both graded sahih by al-Albani — Hisn al-Muslim 71, 75

duas.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul huwallahu ahad, Allahus-samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq, min sharri ma khalaq, wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab, wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-uqad, wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas, malikin-nas, ilahin-nas, min sharril-waswasil-khannas, alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas, minal-jinnati wan-nas

meaning.en: Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.

source.ar: سور الإخلاص والفلق والناس — بعد كل صلاة: رواه أبو داود (١٥٢٣)، صححه الألباني
source.en: Surahs 112–114 — after each prayer: Abu Dawud 1523 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul huwallahu ahad, Allahus-samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq, min sharri ma khalaq, wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab, wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-uqad, wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas, malikin-nas, ilahin-nas, min sharril-waswasil-khannas, alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas, minal-jinnati wan-nas

meaning.en: Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.

source.ar: سور الإخلاص والفلق والناس — ثلاثًا صباحًا ومساءً: رواه أبو داود (٥٠٨٢)، حسنه الألباني
source.en: Surahs 112–114 — three times morning and evening: Abu Dawud 5082 (graded hasan by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ibadatik

meaning.en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

source.ar: رواه أبو داود (١٥٢٢) — دبر كل صلاة، صححه الألباني
source.en: Abu Dawud 1522 — after every prayer (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammad, kama barakta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid

meaning.en: O Allah, send Your prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent them upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

source.ar: رواه البخاري (٣٣٧٠) — والإكثار من الصلاة على النبي ﷺ يوم الجمعة: أبو داود (١٠٤٧)، صححه الألباني
source.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 3370 — sending many blessings on the Prophet ﷺ on Friday: Abu Dawud 1047 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul afwa fa'fu anni

meaning.ar: اللهم إنك عفوٌّ كريم، تحب العفو، فاعف عني.
meaning.en: O Allah, You are Pardoning and love pardon, so pardon me.

source.ar: رواه ابن ماجه (٣٨٥٠) والترمذي (٣٥١٣) عن عائشة رضي الله عنها
source.en: Narrated by Aisha (ra) — Ibn Majah 3850, at-Tirmidhi 3513

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana abduk, wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika alayya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant

meaning.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

source.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 6306 — the master of seeking forgiveness

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min indik, warhamni, innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim

meaning.en: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins but You. So forgive me with forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me; You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

source.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 834, Sahih Muslim 2705

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhart, wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lant, wa ma asraft, wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni, antal-Muqaddimu wa antal-Mu'akhkhir, la ilaha illa ant

meaning.en: O Allah, forgive me what I have done before and what I have left for after, what I have hidden and what I have shown, what I have overdone, and what You know better than I. You bring forward and You hold back; there is no god but You.

source.en: Sahih Muslim 771

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa tub alayya innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim

meaning.en: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.

source.en: Abu Dawud 1516 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin

meaning.en: There is no god but You. Glory be to You! I have indeed been among the wrongdoers.

source.en: Quran 21:87 — at-Tirmidhi 3505

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar

meaning.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

source.ar: سورة البقرة: ٢٠١ — وكان أكثر دعاء النبي ﷺ: البخاري (٦٣٨٩)
source.en: Quran 2:201 — the Prophet's ﷺ most frequent dua: al-Bukhari 6389

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar

meaning.en: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.

source.en: Abu Dawud 792 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-afafa wal-ghina

meaning.en: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and contentment.

source.en: Sahih Muslim 2721

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslih li diniyal-ladhi huwa ismatu amri, wa aslih li dunyayal-lati fiha ma'ashi, wa aslih li akhiratiyal-lati fiha ma'adi, waj'alil-hayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayr, waj'alil-mawta rahatan li min kulli sharr

meaning.en: O Allah, set right my religion, which is the safeguard of my affairs; set right my worldly life, in which I live; and set right my Hereafter, to which I return. Make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a rest for me from every evil.

source.en: Sahih Muslim 2720

duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.transliteration: Ya Muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi ala dinik

meaning.en: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

source.ar: رواه الترمذي (٣٥٢٢) — وكان أكثر دعائه ﷺ
source.en: at-Tirmidhi 3522 — among the Prophet's ﷺ most frequent duas

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab

meaning.en: Our Lord, do not let our hearts swerve after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself; You are the Bestower.

source.en: Quran 3:8

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin

meaning.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

source.en: Quran 7:23

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab

meaning.en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the reckoning takes place.

source.en: Quran 14:41

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama

meaning.en: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and children comfort for our eyes, and make us leaders of the God-conscious.

source.en: Quran 25:74

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal

meaning.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by others.

source.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 6369

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni abduk, ibnu abdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyati biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, adlun fiyya qada'uk, as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fi kitabik, aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqik, awista'tharta bihi fi ilmil-ghaybi indak, an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jala'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi

meaning.en: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand; Your judgement over me is done, and Your decree for me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours — that You named Yourself with, revealed in Your Book, taught to any of Your creation, or kept with Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen — to make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the remover of my sadness and the end of my worry.

source.ar: رواه أحمد، صححه الألباني — حصن المسلم ١٢٠
source.en: Ahmad (graded sahih by al-Albani) — Hisn al-Muslim 120

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn, wa aslih li sha'ni kullah, la ilaha illa ant

meaning.en: O Allah, it is Your mercy I hope for, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye. Set right all my affairs; there is no god but You.

source.ar: رواه أبو داود (٥٠٩٠)، حسن الألباني إسناده
source.en: Abu Dawud 5090 (chain graded hasan by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri

meaning.en: My Lord, open my chest for me and make my task easy for me.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma

meaning.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

source.en: Quran 20:114

duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa sharri ma ba'dah. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar, Rabbi a'udhu bika min adhabin fin-nari wa adhabin fil-qabr

meaning.en: We have reached the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

source.ar: رواه مسلم (٢٧٢٣) — بلفظ الصباح كما في حصن المسلم ٧٧
source.en: Sahih Muslim 2723 — morning wording as in Hisn al-Muslim 77

duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa khayra ma ba'daha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa sharri ma ba'daha. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar, Rabbi a'udhu bika min adhabin fin-nari wa adhabin fil-qabr

meaning.en: We have reached the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

source.en: Sahih Muslim 2723

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur

meaning.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

source.en: Abu Dawud 5068 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur

meaning.en: O Allah, by You we enter the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

source.en: Abu Dawud 5068 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-afwa wal-afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahummastur awrati wa amin raw'ati. Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi, wa an yamini wa an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'azamatika an ughtala min tahti

meaning.en: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unawares from beneath me.

source.en: Abu Dawud 5074 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَشَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma fatiras-samawati wal-ard, alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi wa sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih

meaning.en: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Lord and Sovereign of all things: I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, and from the evil of Satan and his call to associate others with You.

source.en: Abu Dawud 5067 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-Sami'ul-Alim

meaning.en: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

source.en: Abu Dawud 5088 (graded sahih by al-Albani)

duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, birahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullah, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn

meaning.en: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek help: set right all my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

source.ar: رواه الحاكم، صححه الألباني — حصن المسلم ٨٨
source.en: al-Hakim (graded sahih by al-Albani) — Hisn al-Muslim 88

duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
duas.transliteration: Asbahna ala fitratil-islam, wa ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa ala dini nabiyyina Muhammad, wa ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin

meaning.en: We have reached the morning upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of sincere faith, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and devoted to Allah, who was not one of the polytheists.

source.ar: رواه أحمد، صححه الألباني — حصن المسلم ٩٠
source.en: Ahmad (graded sahih by al-Albani) — Hisn al-Muslim 90

duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
duas.transliteration: Amsayna ala fitratil-islam, wa ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa ala dini nabiyyina Muhammad, wa ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin

meaning.en: We have reached the evening upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of sincere faith, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and devoted to Allah, who was not one of the polytheists.

source.ar: رواه أحمد، صححه الألباني — حصن المسلم ٩٠ (بلفظ المساء)
source.en: Ahmad (graded sahih by al-Albani) — Hisn al-Muslim 90, evening wording

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih

meaning.en: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.

source.ar: رواه مسلم (٢٦٩٢) — مائة مرة صباحًا ومساءً
source.en: Sahih Muslim 2692 — a hundred times morning and evening

duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir

meaning.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

source.ar: رواه النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة، صححه الألباني — حصن المسلم ٩٢
source.en: an-Nasa'i, 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Layla (graded sahih by al-Albani) — Hisn al-Muslim 92

duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, adada khalqih, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata arshih, wa midada kalimatih

meaning.en: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, by the number of His creation, by His own pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.

source.en: Sahih Muslim 2726

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa amalan mutaqabbala

meaning.en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and deeds that are accepted.

source.ar: رواه ابن ماجه (٩٢٥) — بعد صلاة الصبح
source.en: Ibn Majah 925 — after the Fajr prayer

duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq

meaning.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

source.ar: رواه مسلم (٢٧٠٩) — ثلاثًا في المساء كما في حصن المسلم ٩٧
source.en: Sahih Muslim 2709 — three times in the evening, as in Hisn al-Muslim 97

duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh

meaning.en: I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance.

source.ar: البخاري (٦٣٠٧) ومسلم (٢٧٠٢) — مائة مرة في اليوم
source.en: Sahih al-Bukhari 6307, Sahih Muslim 2702 — a hundred times a day
